name: Worldwide Aluminium Limited
about: Worldwide Aluminium Limited engages in the trading of aluminum coils and related items in India. It provides blister and pharma foils, aluminum sheets and coils, and closure stocks; and aluminium foils and strips, and polypropylene caps. The company offers household food packaging. The company was formerly known as Worldwide Leather Exports Limited and changed its name to Worldwide Aluminium Limited in October 2019. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in New Delhi, India.
